key_insight: A unified round-clamp transformer enables sound zonotopic bounds on neural-network quantization error, with linear constraints tightening the analysis.
engineering_relevance: The framework can accelerate quantized ReLU network verification while providing mathematically sound error bounds.
method: Model rounding and clamping jointly using a zonotope abstract transformer.
Add linear constraints through constrained zonotopes to tighten error bounds.
Prove soundness, affine-strip optimality, and convex-hull optimality for the complete constrained formulation.
evidence_signal: On ACAS Xu at perturbation radii r=3 and r=6, constrained zonotopes reduced average bound widths by approximately 70–85% and runtimes by 65–80% versus QEBVerif’s symbolic DRA; plain zonotopes were nearly 300× faster on average.
watch_item: Gains vary across bitwidths, and symbolic DRA produces tighter bounds at larger perturbation radii.
paper_title: Zonotopic Analysis of Quantization Error in Neural Networks
